title: I combined two things I love, strategy board games and gyro archery, and it turned out more fun than I expected
author: office-canard
selftext:
I love strategy board games, and I love phone archery games where you tilt the phone to aim with the gyro and release to shoot. SCOPE & LANDMINE is what happened when I put the two together.



AI invaders come at your PC across a grid, with their HP and traits in full view. You decide who to take out first, whether to shoot or lay a mine, and in what order. Then you tilt your phone and actually take the shot, and the score of the shot becomes the damage.



It turned out more fun than I expected, because the two keep handing off to each other. The puzzle tells you the right move, but if your aim slips, the plan falls apart, and you're back to thinking with a new situation to solve. Head, then hands, then head again.



How AI fit in: All of it is code written by Claude.
